intro.data: Vertical composition makes natural transformations behave like arrows: they compose, and there's a do-nothing one (the identity transformation) that acts as a unit. So functors are 'objects' and natural transformations are 'arrows' one level up — the functor category [C, D]. Here, compose 'As a List' (Optional⇒List) with safeHead (List⇒Optional): the round trip wraps then unwraps, changing nothing — it's the identity arrow on Optional. Pick that round-trip composite; the lossy one isn't natural.
intro.alchemy: Vertical composition makes natural transformations behave like arrows: they compose, with a do-nothing one as unit. Functors are the 'objects', natural transformations the 'arrows' — the functor category [C, D]. Here, compose 'As a Bundle' with 'Take First': the round trip changes nothing — the identity arrow. Pick that composite; the lossy one isn't natural.
intro.spellcraft: Vertical composition makes natural transformations behave like arrows: they compose, with a do-nothing one as unit. Functors are the 'objects', natural transformations the 'arrows' — the functor category [C, D]. Here, compose 'As a Web' with 'Take Top': the round trip changes nothing — the identity arrow. Choose that composite; the lossy one isn't natural.
intro.abstract: In the functor category [C, D], functors are objects and natural transformations are morphisms under vertical composition, with id_F as identities. Build β·α where α : F⇒G, β : G⇒H = F (a round trip): β·α = id_F. Pick it; a non-natural family is the distractor.

afterSuccess.data: Composing 'As a List' with safeHead round-tripped right back to the same Optional, unchanged — the composite is the identity transformation on Optional. That's the last piece: natural transformations compose (vertical composition), and the do-nothing transformation is a unit, so functors-and-natural-transformations form a category in their own right — the functor category [C, D], written D^C. The 'Lossy Round Trip' wasn't the identity and broke the square.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Composing the two methods round-tripped back unchanged — the composite is the identity transformation. Natural transformations compose with a do-nothing unit, so functors and natural transformations form the functor category [C, D].
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Composing the two workings round-tripped back unchanged — the composite is the identity transformation. Natural transformations compose with a do-nothing unit, so functors and natural transformations form the functor category [C, D].
afterSuccess.abstract: β·α = id_F (a round trip). With vertical composition associative and id_F a unit, [C, D] satisfies the category axioms: functors are its objects, natural transformations its morphisms.

reveal.summary: The functor category [C, D] (also D^C) has functors C → D as objects and natural transformations as morphisms, with vertical composition as composition and id_F as identities. Natural transformations are 'just morphisms', one level up.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: Type constructors as objects; polymorphic functions between them as morphisms.
